# Glassmorphism

Depth with discipline. Translucent layers over a luminous atmosphere.

## Use

Use for product showcases, interactive learning hubs, and selected dashboard surfaces.

## Essential traits

- Layer separation and bounded transparency
- Subtle luminous background
- Readable opaque or nearly opaque text zones

## Typography

System sans-serif with strong heading weights and readable body text.

## Layout and surfaces

Layered surfaces, stable reading zones, controlled background accents. 20px corners, translucent dark surfaces, backdrop blur where supported, opaque fallback.

## Palette

- background: #111b40
- surface: #17264e
- text: #f3f5ff
- muted: #c3cde6
- accent: #c7f4ff
- border: #6b7aab

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Glassmorphism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with strong heading weights and readable body text. Layered surfaces, stable reading zones, controlled background accents. 20px corners, translucent dark surfaces, backdrop blur where supported, opaque fallback. Palette: background #111b40, surface #17264e, text #f3f5ff, muted #c3cde6, accent #c7f4ff, border #6b7aab. Essential traits: Layer separation and bounded transparency; Subtle luminous background; Readable opaque or nearly opaque text zones. Avoid: Transparency as the only boundary; Blur required to understand content; Animations behind reading text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
